description: Controlled topic vocabulary for BC strata. Every item's topics[] must use ids from this list. Add a topic here before using it anywhere else.

topics.label: Pets
topics.description: Pet bylaws, limits on number and type of pets, grandfathering of existing pets, guide and assistance animals.

topics.label: Noise
topics.description: Unreasonable noise from strata lots or common property, quiet hours, flooring transmission, music and parties.

topics.label: Nuisance
topics.description: Use of a strata lot that causes a nuisance or hazard or unreasonably interferes with others, including odours and smoke drift.

topics.label: Rentals
topics.description: Long-term rental of strata lots, rental restriction bylaws and their limits, Form K and landlord obligations.

topics.label: Short-term rentals
topics.description: Airbnb-style and other short-term accommodation, bylaws restricting them, provincial short-term rental rules.

topics.label: Parking
topics.description: Parking stalls, visitor parking, assignment and leasing of stalls, towing and vehicle bylaws.

topics.label: Smoking and cannabis
topics.description: Smoking and vaping bylaws, cannabis use and growing, smoke drift between units.

topics.label: Alterations and renovations
topics.description: Owner alterations to strata lots and common property, approval requirements, indemnity agreements, flooring and structural changes.

topics.label: Move-in and move-out
topics.description: Moving procedures, elevator bookings, move fees and their limits under the Regulation.

topics.label: Fines
topics.description: Fines for bylaw and rule contraventions, maximum amounts, continuing contraventions and collection limits.

topics.label: Bylaw enforcement and s.135
topics.description: The procedure a strata corporation must follow before imposing fines or other penalties, including written particulars and the opportunity to answer.

topics.label: Hearings
topics.description: Owner and tenant hearings before council, how to request one, timing of the hearing and the written decision.

topics.label: Council and governance
topics.description: Strata council powers and duties, council meetings, conflicts of interest, delegation and standard of care.

topics.label: General meetings and voting
topics.description: Annual and special general meetings, notice, quorum, proxies, majority, 3/4 and 80% votes.

topics.label: Special levies
topics.description: Approval, calculation, collection and refund of special levies.

topics.label: Contingency reserve fund
topics.description: CRF contributions, minimums, and permitted expenditures with and without a vote.

topics.label: Strata fees and arrears
topics.description: Calculation of strata fees, collection of arrears, interest, liens and Certificate of Lien.

topics.label: Insurance and deductibles
topics.description: Strata corporation insurance requirements, deductible chargebacks to owners, owner insurance.

topics.label: Repair and maintenance
topics.description: Who must repair and maintain common property, common assets and strata lots, and related bylaws.

topics.label: Common property use
topics.description: Use of common property and common assets, amenity rules, short-term exclusive use.

topics.label: Limited common property
topics.description: Designation of limited common property, owner rights and responsibilities over LCP such as balconies and patios.

topics.label: Human rights and accommodation
topics.description: Discrimination and the duty to accommodate under the Human Rights Code, including disability, family status and age.

topics.label: Privacy and records
topics.description: Records the strata corporation must keep, owner access to records, and privacy obligations for personal information.

topics.label: Civil Resolution Tribunal process
topics.description: How strata disputes go to the CRT, jurisdiction, remedies, timelines and enforcement of orders.

topics.label: Bylaw amendment and filing
topics.description: Passing, amending and repealing bylaws, filing with the Land Title Office, and when amendments take effect.

topics.label: Depreciation report
topics.description: Depreciation report requirements, timing, exemptions and their use in planning.

topics.label: Water leaks
topics.description: Water ingress and leaks between units or from common property, responsibility, investigation and chargebacks.

topics.label: Hoarding and safety
topics.description: Hoarding, fire and life-safety hazards in strata lots, access to lots for inspection and repair.

topics.label: Harassment
topics.description: Harassment of or by owners, occupants, council members or the property manager, and related bylaws.

topics.label: Electrical planning reports
topics.description: The electrical planning report a strata corporation must obtain, who is qualified to prepare it, what it must contain, and the deadlines and exemptions that decide when it is due.

topics.label: EV charging
topics.description: Installing and operating electric vehicle charging infrastructure in a strata: an owner's request to alter common property, how the strata corporation must consider it, the vote required, and exclusive use of a stall with charging installed.
